- Overestimate prices in bullish sentiment periods (positive sentiment > 0.10) — reduce forecast peak by 5–10%.
- Underestimate prices after strong upward spikes (sentiment < -0.30) — add 3–5% buffer to prevent premature reversal.
- Lagged mean reversion: if 3–5 day sentiment is negative and price is rising, reduce forecast slope by 10–15%.
- Overshoot correction: if forecast exceeds true outcome by >10% in 3–5 consecutive days, apply downward adjustment of 2–4% per day.
- Sentiment-driven bias: if sentiment is consistently negative (avg < -0.20), reduce forecast by 3–7% to align with downward drift.
- Horizon-specific: 30-day forecasts overestimate in high volatility periods — cap forecast at 1.5x recent 14-day average unless sentiment strongly bullish.
